profile_text.body:
OctoAI is listed as a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with octo.ai as its website. The text harvested from that site does not describe OctoAI itself. It is NVIDIA material about GPUs, accelerated computing, AI models, robotics platforms, and related hardware and software, so it does not support any description of OctoAI's own products, services, or customers.

The record holds no products for OctoAI, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in Washington, with a count of 114. Beyond the founding year, headquarters, and website, the material available does not describe what the company builds or where it stands in the AI market.
